newsitem.title: SYRIA: Iranian minister in Syria for military talks.
newsitem.headline: Iranian minister in Syria for military talks.

text.p: Iranian Defence Minister Mohammad Forouzandeh arrived in Damascus on Thursday evening for talks on military cooperation, officials said.
They said Syrian Defence Minister Lieutenant-General Mustafa Tlas welcomed the Iranian minister, who was accompanied by a military delegation, at Damascus airport.

Syria, which has had close ties with Tehran since the Islamic Revolution in 1979, backed Iran in its war with Iraq between 1980 and 1988. Both Syria and Iran support Lebanon's Hizbollah (Party of God) which is fighting against Israel's military presence in south Lebanon.
